name: Tennessee
agencyName: Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security (Driver Services)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Same day retake generally not allowed; return on a later day
retake.retakeFee: No separate knowledge-test fee; permit application fee applies

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night), certified by parent/guardian
gdl.nightCurfew: Intermediate: no driving 11 p.m.-6 a.m. (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: Intermediate: no more than 1 passenger (with exceptions for family)

requiredDocuments: Proof of U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency
Primary and secondary proof of identity
process.realIdNotes: Tennessee offers a REAL ID-compliant license marked with a gold star. Since May 7, 2025, a REAL ID or passport is needed to board domestic flights and enter certain federal facilities.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Adults 18+: 12 or more points in 12 months triggers a proposed suspension; drivers under 18: 6 or more points in 12 months triggers the juvenile suspension process
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, utility, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced limit as posted (commonly 15 mph) when warning flashers are operating

references.label: Driver license fees
references.citation: TN Department of Safety, Driver Services fees
